title: PTO policy
text: Employees receive 18 PTO days per calendar year. Unused PTO carryover is capped at 5 days.

title: Holiday policy
text: ExampleCorp provides 11 paid company holidays per year. The holiday calendar is published every December.

title: Remote work policy
text: Employees may work remotely 2 days per week with approval. Remote work requests must be submitted 3 days ahead.

title: Expense policy
text: The meal reimbursement limit is $35 per day. Expense receipts must be submitted within 30 days.

title: Benefits policy
text: ExampleCorp reimburses a wellness allowance of $240 per year. Benefits enrollment closes after 20 days.

title: Leave approval guide
text: Managers must respond to PTO leave approval requests within 4 business days. This manager guidance supplements the PTO policy.

title: Staffing guide
text: Managers must maintain a minimum of 3 staff members on the support shift. Staffing exceptions require director approval.

title: Team budget guide
text: Managers may approve travel reimbursement expenses up to $750. Larger expenses require director approval.

title: Performance review guide
text: Managers schedule performance reviews every 6 months. Review notes remain restricted to managers and HR.

title: Hiring guide
text: Hiring requests require 2 approvals before an offer is issued. Managers submit requests through the hiring form.
